bad.title: The ticket already picks the fix
bad.text: A red badge on the bell is decided before anyone asks why replies get missed.

bad.title: Built well, in 4 minutes
bad.text: The agent does exactly what the ticket says, so the speed hides the wrong question.
bad.wait: Press Send to agent to see this.

bad.title: 3 of 5 still miss the reply
bad.text: They don’t look at the bell while they write, so the fast build was wasted.
bad.wait: Press Send to agent, then Check with people to see this.

good.title: Problem, goal and a test
good.text: People miss replies, should notice one within a day, and 4 of 5 must pass.

good.title: Three answers to the question
good.text: A badge, a highlight in the doc or a daily email. The highlight is picked.
good.wait: Press Send to agent to see this.

good.title: 5 of 5 notice the reply
good.text: It shows up where people are already reading.
good.wait: Press Send to agent, then Check with people to see this.

bad.title: The brief lists two checks
bad.text: “Lisbn” and “Barcellona” are right there, and nobody types them in.

bad.title: Done the moment it ships
bad.text: The ticket closes at Ship, and the team moves on.

bad.title: The problem comes back as support
bad.text: “I typed Barcellona and got no results,” two weeks after the ticket closed.
bad.wait: Press Ship, then Two weeks later to see this.

good.title: The brief becomes the test
good.text: Both spellings from the brief get typed into the real app after shipping.

good.title: One passes, one fails
good.text: “Lisbn” finds Lisbon, but “Barcellona” still gets no results.

good.title: The lesson starts round 2
good.text: Doubled letters become the next problem, before any support request arrives.
good.wait: Press Ship, Write down what we learned, then Start the next round to see this.

bad.title: The first idea it had
bad.text: One approach in 3 files, with nothing to compare it to.

bad.title: A question nobody can answer
bad.text: Three weeks later, a reviewer asks why errors come after Sign up. Nobody knows.
bad.wait: Press Merge, then Three weeks later to see this.

good.title: Three options, each with a cost
good.text: Errors after Sign up are fast to build, but people fail once first.

good.title: One line about why
good.text: Record the decision stays off until an option is picked and a reason typed.

good.title: The reason lives in the PR
good.text: Anyone who asks later reads the choice and why, not a guess.
good.wait: Pick an option, write why, then press Record the decision to see this.

bad.title: 12 tests, all green
bad.text: Each one checks a case the agent thought of, like posting or an empty comment.

bad.title: The keyboard covers Post
bad.text: A bug report from a phone the next day, a case no test listed.

good.title: The brief names the phone
good.text: “People can comment from their phone” is the case to walk through by hand.

good.title: One tap shows the problem
good.text: The keyboard rises and covers Post, before anything is merged.
good.wait: Press Try it on a phone, then tap the comment field to see this.

good.title: Back to Build, minutes later
good.text: One more test gets added instead of a bug report.
good.wait: Press Try it on a phone, then tap the comment field to see this.

bad.title: A hunch written as fact
bad.text: “Build a template gallery” assumes templates are what new people need.

bad.title: Done means shipped
bad.text: Nothing in the brief says what result would count as success.

bad.title: Two weeks, and nothing learned
bad.text: Few people open it, and nobody knows if the idea or the place was wrong.
bad.wait: Press Ship it to see this.

good.title: A question to answer
good.text: Do new people reach a first result faster from a template than from a blank canvas?

good.title: What would change our minds
good.text: If people pick a template and then delete most of it, the hunch is wrong.

good.title: Learn rewrites the brief
good.text: People kept the layout, so round 2 tests a layout-only starter, again in two days.
good.wait: Press Finish round 1 to see this.

bad.title: A verdict with nothing to check
bad.text: “Cleaner and more modern” is the whole reason given for B.

bad.title: B beats options nobody saw
bad.text: Nobody can say later why it won.
bad.wait: Press Use B to see this.

good.title: The ask is for trade-offs
good.text: Three options, and what each one is good at and costs.

good.title: B’s cost is out in the open
good.text: Short pages, but some settings hide in tabs.

good.title: The pick comes with its cost
good.text: Choosing C means knowing it’s hard to browse.
good.wait: Pick an option to see this.

bad.title: One file at a time
bad.text: Each file is opened by hand to count the hits in it.

bad.title: About an hour and a half
bad.text: 3 files take 6 minutes, and 45 are still left.
bad.wait: Press Open the next file three times to see this.

good.title: 16 files for each agent
good.text: Three agents split the 48 files and search at the same time.

good.title: 23 uses found in 2 minutes
good.text: The list comes back sorted by file, ready to read.
good.wait: Press Send to 3 agents to see this.

good.title: The person still decides
good.text: What each use should become is the part left for people.
good.wait: Press Send to 3 agents to see this.

bad.title: Explore misreads the task
bad.text: “The problem is speed” flows straight into the plan.

bad.title: 14 files built on it
bad.text: A cache makes export faster, and nobody stopped to read why.

bad.title: Faster, and still hidden
bad.text: People still can’t find Export, after all 14 files changed.

good.title: A stop after Explore
good.text: The agent waits with “The problem is speed,” so the misreading gets corrected.

good.title: The plan follows the correction
good.text: Move Export from the File menu into the toolbar.
good.wait: Press Start, then Correct it to see this.

good.title: 2 files, found on the first try
good.text: People see Export right away.
good.wait: Press Start, Correct it, then Approve the plan to see this.

bad.title: 14 files, 612 lines added
bad.text: The approach is read for the first time after it runs through everything.

bad.title: Fixing it means building again
bad.text: A new ShareModal instead of the existing Dialog is in all 14 files.
bad.wait: Press Review the PR to see this.

good.title: Four lines, nothing built
good.text: The whole approach fits in a list that takes a minute to read.

good.title: Step 2 caught in the plan
good.text: Reuse the existing Dialog instead of a new ShareModal, before any file changes.
